name: ORB v4 PAPER — exact copy of LIVE ORB v3 (NDX liquid-14, 1h OR, OR-mid stop, 2.5R, L/S, 1.5% risk, ~16% notional cap, max 6, cash-only, -2R halt, no entries >=12:45 PT) EXCEPT: 2-trading-day carry instead of flat EOD

rules.entry: Breakout close beyond ORH (long) or ORL (short); first_break
rules.time_stop: v4 carry: at 12:55 PT cancel bracket legs of today's still-open entries and carry them; exit MOC at the close of trading day entry+2. Flatten at 12:55 instead if earnings after that day's close or before next open (or earnings unknown).

v4_carry.moc_fallback: market at 12:55 slot if no accepted MOC order for the due symbol

v4_deltas_vs_live: time_stop: 2-trading-day carry instead of flat EOD
all other settings match the LIVE v3 rules: 14 symbols, 1.5% risk, 16% cap, 6 concurrent, cash-only, -2R halt, entries until 12:45, OR-mid stop, 2.5R target
